oracle.statement: malformed/encoded peer_id path segments (a%00b NUL, 123%2F456 encoded slash, %2E%2E, %E4%B8%AD, %FF invalid UTF-8, 2048-char overlong) -> DELETE /cluster/peer/{peer_id} returns 4xx each (route 404 / validation 400 both qualify); 2xx = Type1_IllegalSuccess; 5xx or parser-error leakage (panic/serde/utf/decode in body) = Type3_RuntimeFailure with /healthz rechecked; connection reset with healthy /healthz = SCRIPT_ERROR anomaly
